My sensitive skin, particularly with rosacea, often leads to compromised barrier integrity and an increased susceptibility to redness, inflammation, and breakouts. This cleanser also boasts a completely scent-free formula, which is a non-negotiable requirement for

My skin felt nourished as well as smooth when completely washed off. The scent is light and clean and it's a great cleanser. A little goes a long way so it lasts a while as well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my first experience with this brand and I have to say I'm impressed! It definitely has helped make my skin very soft and hasn't broke me out. It's very good for sensitive and dry skin.

avis.titre: Yes, I would buy it again
avis.texte: I absolutely love Exuvience. It has been a great product for my skin. It has gotten very difficult to find the full line of product though. I wish Ulta would keep it better stocked.

avis.titre: Exigence is The best product that I have found to use on my
avis.texte: I love the existence product. It's one of the best that I have found. I am disappointed that Alta does not keep it stocked all the time. It's gotten very difficult to find the full line of product.
This cleanser works with water or without, and is non-drying for my combination skin.
Good cleanser that removes eye makeup and leaves my face clean without any irritation. I don't wear mascara so this works well to remove all of my makeup.
Love this stuff, gets my face clean, not taut or itchy afterward, and much more reasonable price than what I've been using. Thanks! ps. I have a 76 year old dry face :)

avis.titre: Game changer for dry reactive skin
avis.texte: When I bought this I actually had gone into the store to buy Sunday Rileys cleanser but it was out of stock. One of the Employees recommended this product based upon my skin and I am more satisfied with this than the one I had intended to repurchase.

Feels okay when I havent worn makeup, but if i'm wearing makeup it just smears around my face and doesnt come off. It makes me question how well it cleans even when i dont wear make up. Used this product for two months and experienced cystic acne ive never had before. Not a fan.
exuviance is amazing and their cleansers are top notch, this one is no exception. I love how it feels and smells, and it works extremely well. Thank you for this wonderful product.

I really wanted to embrace this facial cleanser, unfortunately; I simply can't! It doesn't clean my face at all, my makeup still remains in my pores, my skin has a residue, and I'm seeing little tiny impurity bumps. This one is a NO for me.

I have strugggled for many years to find a cleanser that would not irritate my very sensitive, reactive skin. In my youth I had extremely oily skin and struggled with acne but, a lot of the products prescribed and/or recommended dried out my skin, caused irritation, redness and sometimes itchiness. I have used foaming cleansers for most of my life but I really prefer the feel and texture of a creamy cleanser. I have another creamy cleanser that I have used in the past and it worked very well but the fragrance was just too much for my sensitive skin so I stopped using the brand all together. I have read some reviews that stated this product does not have a fragrance to it but unless the formula has changed recently my creamy cleanser has a very pleasant scent to it and it does not irritate my skin. I agree with some of the other reviewers that it does not remove all of your makeup (I wear Estée Lauder's Double Wear Foundation) but for me it does remove I would say about 95% of my makeup. I will use a soft wash cloth dampened with warm (not very warm next to hot) water to softly remove the cleanser and whatever makeup, dirt, pollution and oils that are on my skin at the end of the day. I also use the same cleanser in the morning but, can just rinse off with warm water, pat my face and neck dry and my skin is very clean and soft. No film or residue left! If you'd have sensitive and/or reactive skin, give this cleanser a try you might be pleasantly surprised. Oh, a little product

I have used this for several years, but this last container I just purchased has no fragrance. It used to smell so good like pineapple. Why did you remove the fragrance? Its not the same. Can't give it 5 stars anymore.
A gentle cleanser that does not the leave my skin oily. I use this cleanser when I am using an exfoliating product afterward.

I have been struggling with acne for the past 3 years. Im not sure why, but I have tried literally every product that has been recommended to me, and I've given each a fair amount of time, as I know nothing is a quick fix. I decided to ask on a whim while in the store for a facial cleaner that had nothing in it, just something to clean my face without causing more breakouts, purging, etc. The girl walked me over to this, I purchased without any hopes of anything more than just a cleanser for sensitive skin. Well let me tell you…this stuff is a miracle in a bottle. I know how extra that sounds, but I've using this once a day at night before bedtime, paired with Drunk Elephant protini cream for the past several weeks..and my face hasnt been this clear, soft and young looking in YEARS. Its a little pricey for face wash…but definitely worth a try. Buy it. If this continues to work this well for me, im a customer forever.
I have very sensitive skin. This brand is wonderful and does not irritate at all. No fragrance. I will not use another brand.

This is probably the most expensive face wash I've ever purchased but in my opinion it's so worth it! It made me break out so bad when I first started using it (I've heard that means it's really working) but now my skin is the most clear it's been in so long, will definitely be repurchasing once it's empty

I'm not really sure if it's the fragrance that is making my skin feel irritated or I just have REALLY sensitive skin ( which I know I have very sensitive skin) but I thought with this cleanser being "gentle" it would be kind to my skin. This is the second cleanser I've used from this brand the first one being the "pore clarifying" cleanser and honestly these two cleaners have my face reacting the same way. I do love this brand my face is so glowy and my pores look none existent when using there products. They don't make my face red but I face feels irritated and dry even tho it's not . So idk I wish they made a gentle cleanser without fragrance.

avis.titre: Very nice! But do I love it?
avis.texte: On a quest to find a very gentle cleanser (ideally with anti-aging properties) that leaves skin feeling clean. My experience is they either clean well and cause redness/burning sensation that takes hours to resolve (like I look/feel sunburned) or they're so gentle my skin doesn't feel clean enough. An Ulta rep suggested this Exuviance gentle cream cleanser. Smells good but not over-powering. Feels very good. A soft plush pearly white cream that does not foam or get sudsy. Cleans fairly well and leaves skin lightly moisturized. Decent sized tube so it's somewhat economical. I like it a lot and would buy it again. Do I love it? No.
This is my only go to cleanser. It is silky, gets off makeup, not harsh and feels so clean after without drying out my skin

This is my favorite new cleanser! Smells nice, gets my makeup off (I prefer a natural look tho), leaves my skin very smooth. I love that I can use without water in the morning as well. I also like the Fresh soy cleanser and the Cle de Peau foaming cleanser and this is right up there with those for me. It's perfect for travel too.

avis.titre: Exuviance has been my go to for years!
avis.texte: I use this in the morning and the bioactive foam at night. Good stuff!
This is the only cleanser I use. Softly cleans my skin. Nothing harsh. I use it twice a day and I have been using the Gentle Cream Cleanser for many years.
I just love this cleanser and have been using it every single night to remove my makeup for over 20 years. It's gentle yet effective.
This is my 2nd time purchasing this face wash. Very nice lotion to use for cleaning make up off. Nice fragrant.

avis.titre: Nice cleanser, great for dry skin.
avis.texte: My face breaks out and I always use harsh oil preventing products. The Rep told me my skin was flaky and red from the wrong products, and suggested I use this cleanser. I like it a lot and the flakiness is going away. It is very gentle on skin.

i absolutely love this cleanser! it has been the only thing my sensitive skin can handle and since i've used it, i have had less breakouts - to the point where my face is completely clear!! it doesn't strip your skin either! my face always feels so clean and fresh with this product!!

I have used this product for years and loved it -- It was perfect for my super sensitive skin. Unfortunately, when they changed the packaging this last time, they changed the product and added Propylene glycol. That chemical is nasty and makes my skin burn and rash, and it is in EVERYTHING now and being promoted as an anti-aging miracle. Appears it is now marked down as they are discontinuing it. I have loved Exuviance but they have gradually eliminated all the products that I used and replaced them with products that are not truly for sensitive people.

avis.titre: Doesn't strip your skin but doesn't remove make up
avis.texte: Used it for a few days and enjoyed the way it felt. BUT! It took off none of my eye make up and left some foundation. Had to follow up with make up remover. I don't expect Face wash to take all of the make up off but it worked just as well if I just used water. So if you want to use this for make up removal I would avoid. Otherwise seems like a nice product.
Best for sensitive skin. I've been using this for over a year now and it's the BEST. Light cream cleaners that doesn't aggravate my skin!

Definitely not for those with sensitive skin. I gave two stars because it felt really nice the first two days so I think it could work well for those that aren't the same skin type as me. However, for me after about 3 days a rash developed around my mouth. It was painful and took about two weeks to clear up completely. I definitely wouldn't recommend it for everyone..
